_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_DELETE_ACTIVE_SLIDE_DE: This example shows how the carousel behaves when the initially active slide is missing from the provided data.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_EMITS_DESCRIPTION_: This example demonstrates the change and init events emitted by the carousel component.
_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_SOCCER_BALL_: Soccer ball on a red background
_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: A carousel is a component for cyclically displaying elements (images, text, etc.) in a limited space. Users can navigate through the elements using navigation buttons or indicators.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_ARIA_DISABLED_DESCRIPT: The carousel component can be marked as disabled for assistive technologies using the aria-disabled attribute.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_ARROWS_TRIGGER_DESCRIP: The carousel component can display navigation arrows in different ways: always visible, only on hover, only on focus, or on both hover and focus.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_INDICATORS_AUTO_LIMIT_: Example of automatic limitation of the number of indicators depending on the carousel width
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_INDICATORS_LIMIT_DESCR: Example of limiting the number of displayed indicators
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_INDICATORS_TYPE_DESCRI: Example of different types of slide indicators
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARIA_DISABLED_DESCRIPT: Indicates whether the carousel should be marked as disabled for assistive technologies
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARIA_LABEL_DESCRIPTION: Translatable aria-label for the main carousel element
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROW_NEXT_ATTRIBUTES_: Additional attributes for the button that navigates to the next slide and are not explicitly defined as properties
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROW_NEXT_ICON_DESCRI: Icon of the arrow to the next slide. Default: chevron right (vertical: chevron down)
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROW_PREVIOUS_ATTRIBU: Additional attributes for the button that navigates to the previous slide and are not explicitly defined as properties
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROW_PREVIOUS_ICON_DE: Icon of the arrow to the previous slide. Default: chevron left (vertical: chevron up)
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROWS_PLACEMENT_DESCR: Placement of the arrows: sides-center, sides-top or sides-bottom
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROWS_SHOW_DESCRIPTIO: Determines whether navigation buttons (arrows) should be displayed for navigating between slides
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ARROWS_TRIGGER_DESCRIP: When the arrows are visible: always, hover or focus. Hidden arrows stay in the order of the focus and are shown with the focus in the carousel
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_AUTOPLAY_INTERVAL_DESC: Interval in milliseconds between automatic slide transitions
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_AUTOPLAY_SHOW_DESCRIPT: Shows the button to start and stop the rotation, the rotation does not start by itself
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_AUTOPLAY_START_DESCRIP: Starts the rotation after the mount (not with prefers-reduced-motion). The button of the rotation is always shown
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_DATA_DESCRIPTION_: Array of objects with data to display in the carousel
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION_: Determines whether the carousel should be disabled, preventing user interaction
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Specifies a unique identifier for the carousel
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATOR_WIDTH_DESCRI: Size of one indicator, needed to determine the number of indicators if indicatorsAutoLimit true
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATORS_AUTO_LIMIT_: If true, determines the maximum number of indicators based on the element width, used in conjunction with indicatorWidth
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATORS_LIMIT_DESCR: Sets the maximum number of indicators
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATORS_PLACEMENT_D: Placement of the tabs: top, top-start, top-end, bottom, bottom-start, bottom-end or outside (under the slides)
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATORS_SHOW_DESCRI: Determines whether slide indicators should be displayed
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_INDICATORS_TYPE_DESCRI: Type of the tabs: dots, squares or labels (text from key-label)
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_KEY_ID_DESCRIPTION_: A unique key identifier for each data item. Used for performance improvement
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_DESCRIPTIO: Id of the active slide (value of key-id, without it the index). Use with v-model
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPTION_: Object with translatable texts used in the component
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_AUTOPLAY_DESCRIPTION_: With autoplay-start the slides change by themselves every autoplay-interval milliseconds. autoplay-show shows only the button, the user starts the rotation. The button to start and stop the rotation is always shown with the rotation (WCAG 2.2.2) and is the first element in the order of the focus. The rotation stops when the focus goes into the carousel and starts again only with the button. It pauses while the mouse is over the carousel (autoplay-pause-on-hover). With prefers-reduced-motion it does not start by itself. While the slides rotate, the screen reader does not read them (aria-live="off").
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_LOOP_DESCRIPTION_: With :loop="false" the carousel stops at the first and at the last slide. The arrows without a slide in their direction get aria-disabled and keep the focus. The keys in the tabs do not go round, the rotation stops on the last slide.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_TRANSITION_DESCRIPTION: The prop transition sets the animation of the change: slide (default), fade or none. motion-blur adds a blur in the middle of the change. Duration and timing function are CSS variables. With prefers-reduced-motion there is no animation.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_VERTICAL_DESCRIPTION_: With direction="vertical" the slides change from the bottom to the top, the arrows are at the top and at the bottom, the tabs in a column. In the tabs the keys ArrowUp and ArrowDown change the slide. height sets a fixed height of the slides, without it the height is the height of the active slide.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_CARD_DESCRIPTION_: With type="card" the active slide is in the middle, the previous and the next slide are smaller on the sides (card-scale). A click on a side slide activates it. The side slides are hidden for the screen reader and their content can not be focused, the keyboard uses the arrows and the tabs. The vertical mode card needs height.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_LABELS_DESCRIPTION_: key-label is the key of the label in the data. The label is the name of the tab instead of "Slide 3". With indicators-type="labels" the tabs show the labels as text. indicators-placement="outside" shows the controls under the slides instead of over the image.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_ARROWS_PLACEMENT_DESCR: arrows-placement: sides-center (default, the whole height), sides-top or sides-bottom (round buttons). In right-to-left the arrow "previous" is on the right.
_A_CAROUSEL_GROUP_MODEL_DESCRIPTION_: v-model contains the id of the active slide (the value of key-id, without it the index). A change of the model from outside activates the slide. The methods next, previous, setActiveItem, play and stop are available through a ref.
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_AUTOPLAY_PAUSE_ON_HOVE: Pauses the rotation while the mouse is over the carousel
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_CARD_SCALE_DESCRIPTION: Scale of the previous and the next slide in the mode card (from 0 to 1)
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_DIRECTION_DESCRIPTION_: Direction of the change: horizontal or vertical
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_HEIGHT_DESCRIPTION_: Fixed height of the slides as CSS value, e.g. 300px. Without it (or auto) the height of the active slide
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the label in the data. The label is the name of the tab and the text with indicators-type="labels"
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_LOOP_DESCRIPTION_: After the last slide comes the first. With false the carousel stops at the ends
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_MOTION_BLUR_DESCRIPTIO: Adds a blur in the middle of the change of the slide
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_TRANSITION_DESCRIPTION: Animation of the change: slide, fade or none
_A_CAROUSEL_PROPS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_: default or card (the previous and the next slide smaller on the sides)
_A_CAROUSEL_EVENTS_CHANGE_DESCRIPTION_: The active slide changed: { id, item, previousId, previousItem }
_A_CAROUSEL_EVENTS_INIT_DESCRIPTION_: After the creation: { id, item } of the active slide
_A_CAROUSEL_EVENTS_STOP_DESCRIPTION_: The rotation stopped (button, focus in the carousel, last slide without loop, method stop)
_A_CAROUSEL_EVENTS_UPDATE_MODEL_VALUE_DE: Id of the new active slide for v-model
_A_CAROUSEL_EXPOSES_SET_ACTIVE_ITEM_DESC: Activates the slide with the given id
_A_CAROUSEL_SLOTS_ITEM_DESCRIPTION_: Content of a slide: { item, itemIndex, isActive, activeId, dataCount, parentId }
